svg.title: RED LEDGER — Key Visual
svg.desc: Kanegura, a vertical city stacked on the ribcage of a dead god, under a red moon and a sky ruled like ledger paper. In the foreground Akaba Jin raises his red-marked left arm. Title RED LEDGER / 赤い帳簿. Tagline: Everything is borrowed. He's not paying.

g.font-family: 'Noto Sans JP','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue','Arial Black',Arial,sans-serif
g.text: Everything is borrowed. He's not paying.
